MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 122

2. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 72
   C. 17
   D. 1

3. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 12

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 7
   C. 1
   D. 7

5. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 12
   D. 42

7. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 169

8. Solve for x: x + 3 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 3
   C. 10
   D. 7

9. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 1, 6
   D. 2, 4, 6

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 156

11. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

12. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 3/4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — 121
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 11² = 11 × 11
3. 11² = 121
Final Answer: 121
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. B — 72
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Product = first factor × second factor
2. Substitute values: Product = 8 × 9
3. Product = 72
Final Answer: 72
